source_evidence: src/net_class.cpp now defines and binds ActiveNet at original 0x009BE608, publishes this during construction and initializes the window voice inputs; src/net_class.h declares shared storage and original hotkey/member offsets; src/win.cpp restores the lost on_key mapping and consumes the same pointer and named fields, preserving signed and unsigned voice overloads. Strict do_net/check_net and bounded initial object comparisons pass, as do 150 scoped member witnesses and compiler-backed ownership controls. This incorporates shared storage and its live consumers, not full Net construction, Win::on_key matching or lifetime acceptance; the task remains unfinished.
